1.headline: Your handicap, for the simulator
1.body: SimCap tracks your index across every round you play on GSPro, Trackman, Foresight, Full Swing, E6, Garmin and more. Just log your score and sim settings after each round.

2.headline: Compete with your crew
2.body: Create groups, challenge friends to head-to-head matches, and run tournaments — stroke play, scramble, best ball, or single elimination match play. SimCap handles the scoring.

3.headline: Every round makes it smarter
3.body: The more rounds logged across the SimCap community, the more accurately we calibrate difficulty across platforms and courses. Your index gets fairer over time.

contact.intro: We'd love to hear from you — whether it's a bug, a feature idea, or just feedback on how the handicap math feels.

stroke.title: Stroke Play
stroke.sub: Total strokes win. Log your rounds, and the lowest average net score over the tournament wins. The standard format — same as how your SimCap handicap is calculated.

match_play.title: Match Play
match_play.sub: Single-elimination bracket seeded by SimCap index. Win holes to advance — the bracket is the standings. Requires 2–30 players (even number).

scramble.title: Scramble
scramble.sub: Everyone hits, the team picks the best shot, and you all play from there. One team score per hole. The most popular format for group events — every player contributes no matter their handicap.

best_ball.title: Best Ball
best_ball.sub: Everyone plays their own ball the whole round. The lowest score on each hole counts for the team. Log your round independently — SimCap calculates your team score automatically.

match.title: Match Play
match.body: Challenge any SimCap golfer to a head-to-head stroke play match from any simulator, anywhere. Net scores are calculated from your SimCap index and your tee.

groups.title: My Groups
groups.body: Groups let you track handicaps and compete with your regular sim crew. Invite friends to see how your indexes compare.

tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.body: Run a tournament for your crew. The group creator or admins can launch stroke play, match play, scramble, or best ball — with standings that update as players log rounds and hole-by-hole scorecards. Want to tie several tournaments together into one points race? Start a season — it tracks placement points across every tournament in it, with its own standings.
